title: chanio commons, version 1
description: One public file of checked claims that every chanio downloads the same way, with a plain GET and nothing about the person. Matching it to a person's notes runs on their device, and an entry is shown as its own labelled part, never blended into their notes. It never holds a person, a name, health or crisis content, a price, or a venture. commons/check.mjs enforces this shape and the content rules; tests/commons.test.mjs runs it in the stage gate. Decided 2026-11-23 (pull first, give later). An entry is a living knowledge ledger: a claim, its evidence, a verdict and its dated history; its id stays the same when a recheck changes the verdict.

status.description: staged: built for review, never served. published: approved by a person, its sha256 written in commons/approved.json.

entries_sha256.description: sha256, hex, of JSON.stringify(entries). Every chanio recomputes it and uses no entry when it differs.

id.description: c- and the first 12 hex of sha256 over the trimmed, lower-cased claim and the source urls (each once, sorted), joined by newlines. It names the claim and its evidence, so a new verdict, finding or history row does not change it; later rechecks refer to the entry by it.

claim.description: The claim as it was checked. It must stand on its own.

lang.description: The language the claim and finding are written in, a BCP 47 tag (en, hi, pt-BR). The gate's name, health and crisis rules are word lists for English, so it accepts only languages those rules can read (commons/check.mjs LANGS, today en); a device prefers entries in its own language and names the language of any other.

verdict.description: The last check's verdict. PARTLY: part of the claim holds, and the finding says which part. WRONG entries stay in, as checked and wrong.

finding.description: What the check found; for PARTLY, which part holds; for WRONG, what the source says instead. Plain text, no web address.

url.description: A public https page, not a health site and not a venture's own site.

fetched.description: The day the checker fetched the page.

enum: an AI checker that read the cited source
a reviewer who read the cited source
checked_by.description: The last check's checker: a role, never a name.

checked.description: The day of the last check (the last history row's date).

history.description: Every check, oldest first. The seed writes one row; a recheck appends one. The last row's verdict, date and checker are the entry's verdict, checked and checked_by.

enum: an AI checker that read the cited source
a reviewer who read the cited source

words.description: Lower-case words a chanio matches the entry by, against the person's own notes, on their device.
